The user wants me to classify a diseased plant image based on the provided symptom descriptions. I have read the image and now need to analyze its visual features and compare them to the knowledge base.

**Visual Analysis of the Test Image:**
The image shows soybean plants. There are green stems and pods, but also some dried, brown stems and leaves at the bottom. The most prominent feature is a white, fluffy, mold-like growth on one of the dried stems and extending to some of the surrounding plant material and potentially pods. There are also some hard, black, irregular structures (sclerotia) visible on the affected stem.

**Comparing with Symptom Descriptions:**

*   **White Mold:** "Lesions usually develop first at stem nodes during or after flowering. The tops of the plants become grayish-green and then wilt and die. Infected stems often become soft and watery, covered with white moldy growth in moist conditions, or develop a bleached white appearance when dry.. Hard, black sclerotia that resemble rodent droppings develop on or inside infected stems and pods; white fluffy mycelium covers stem lesions under moist conditions."

This description perfectly matches the visual evidence:
*   "white moldy growth" is clearly visible on the stem.
*   "Hard, black sclerotia that resemble rodent droppings develop on or inside infected stems and pods" also matches the black structures seen on the stem.

Other diseases do not present with both white fluffy mold and black sclerotia.
